steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to this Snipe-IT app with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given, it will be filled in automatically). After signing in, report the page title and what the dashboard shows.

02-find: Go to the Assets list page (Assets -> List All or /hardware). Find every asset whose name starts with 'Seed:'. For each one, report its asset tag exactly as displayed and its name exactly as displayed. Do not modify anything. Report the list of pairs.

03-create: Create a new asset (hardware) in this Snipe-IT instance: name it exactly '{{runid}} Bench Asset', model 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose from the searchable model dropdown), status 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from dropdown), default location 'Bench Office' (choose from dropdown), and purchase date 2026-03-15 (use the date picker; if the displayed format differs like 'Wednesday, March 15, 2026', pick that date). Fill any other required fields minimally, do not create new models/locations/statuses/users, and do not modify seed assets. Save it, then report the asset's page showing name, model, status, default location, purchase date, and the auto-assigned asset tag exactly as displayed.

04-create: On the asset page for asset '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{03-create.asset_tag}}, at /hardware/{{03-create.url.p1}}), perform a Check Out: check the asset out to the user 'Bench Assignee' (choose from the searchable user dropdown), and include a note whose text contains '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Checkout for run {{runid}}'). Fill any other required fields minimally (e.g. expected checkin date if required). Do not create new users. Submit the checkout once. Then report the asset page's checkout status: who it is checked out to, the note text, and the asset tag.

05-open: Open the asset page for asset tag {{03-create.asset_tag}} (asset '{{runid}} Bench Asset') and verify, reading only: (a) the asset tag exactly as displayed, (b) the asset name, (c) the model, (d) the status label, (e) the default location, (f) the purchase date, (g) who it is checked out to, and (h) the checkout note text from the History tab. Report each value exactly as shown on the page. Do not change anything.
